pinned.label: ubuntu-24.04
pinned.toolchain: The runner image supplies git, gh, jq, make, gcc, coreutils and the apt archive; those float with the label and are not separately digest-pinned.

surfaces.drift: The label is provider-managed and its image floats within the 24.04 line. The guard refuses any other runner label in the enumerated workflows, and the shard merge receipt records the runner class it ran on. A larger runner class or a different OS is a deliberate registry edit.

The guard requires .node-version and .nvmrc to equal 24.20.0 and every workflow setup-node to read .nvmrc (node-version-file), refusing a workflow that spells an exact node-version; the two floor manifests to share >=24.18.0 <25.0.0; and every declared verification manifest to keep its exact 24.18.0 pin inside that floor range. Any tracked package.json with an engines.node outside this declaration is refused. A Node move changes the two pin files and the manifests.

The guard requires packageManager to equal npm@11.19.0 and refuses any install command other than `npm ci` in workflows and build files. An npm upgrade must move this entry and both floor lockfiles together.

The lockfile must exist, carry lockfileVersion 3 and an integrity hash on every non-link package; the guard refuses npm install/update in the enumerated install path. `npm ci` itself fails a manifest/lock disagreement in CI.

The digest pins the exact image manifest; the tag is retained for readability only. The guard refuses a tag-only FROM and any digest not declared here. A new base image is refused until this declaration is updated.

pinned.builderAction: actions/jekyll-build-pages, pinned by SHA in the github-action surface

surfaces.drift: The Jekyll builder is the SHA-pinned actions/jekyll-build-pages action, and the site's only source is this repository's docs/ (no other repository is read). The tracked docs/_config.yml may load only the plugins declared here, which ship inside that pinned action; the builder may not add plugins:, gems: or remote_theme:. The workflow hands the built commit (github.sha) to Jekyll as build_revision. A new plugin path is refused until this declaration says how it is pinned.

pinned.version: unpinned; selected by name from the Ubuntu 24.04 runner archive

surfaces.drift: The exact package version is runner-image-specific, so the runner label and this name are the pin. The guard refuses any apt package not declared here and any install line the declaration does not name. The compiler itself is declared once, by engine/guardian/Makefile (CC := gcc-14), and both call sites (.github/workflows/ci.yml and .github/workflows/test-shards.yml) install this package and invoke that owner without a CC= literal. This is listed in knownExceptions; the owner is the guardian build owner.
